name: Golden Bell
look: Golden Bell, a protective barrier from cultivation fantasy. A translucent golden-bronze temple bell made of qi covers the character from head to ground, with engraved rune bands round its waist and rim and a warm glow.
subject: bell

parts.name: MAIN
parts.text: the bell alone, whole, its rune bands and rim, no glow, no dust
forms: struck on the right, the struck side flashing white
faded from the rim up to its waist

parts.name: BAND
parts.text: one rune band unrolled flat, its glyphs clear

parts.name: FX
parts.text: the small effects alone, spread out so none overlap: a dust puff, golden motes, a ring of light seen flat

parts.name: LIGHT
parts.text: only the glow of the bell, the light it gives off, with no solid shape drawn

layers.name: SOLID
layers.text: the solid shapes, opaque, with no glow, no sparks and no specks

layers.name: FX
layers.text: the small effects: sparks, specks, chips, flecks and puffs, with no solid shape and no glow

layers.name: LIGHT
layers.text: the glow: the soft light round the shapes and the effects, with no solid shape drawn

rows.name: INIT
rows.caption: shield forms
rows.text: the bell descends from above and settles over the character, landing with a small ring of dust at its rim
notes: only a few faint specks of light, under 20 pixels: the shape is not visible yet
the whole effect fully formed, exactly as MAIN on the parts sheet, as big as in every other moment

rows.name: IDLE
rows.caption: shield holds
rows.text: the bell holds steady; light shimmers down its surface and the rune bands pulse softly. It loops

rows.name: HIT
rows.caption: blow lands from the right
rows.text: a blow strikes the bell's right side. The bell rings: a bright flash at the impact point, a ripple running round the bell, and a ring of light bursting outward, then settling

rows.name: BREAK
rows.caption: shield ends
rows.text: the bell fades from the rim upward and dissolves into rising golden motes
notes: a few last faint specks, under 20 pixels
